The '''G-62 Repulsorsail Skiff''' was an aquatic vehicle made by [[Jal-Paara]] that was widely used in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] c. [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. It combined obsolete [[repulsorsail]] technology with mounted pontoons because it was cheaper than finding a real [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] unit.

There were several available sizes and some of them, such as [[MD-0C6]]'s unit, were customized, sometimes even armed.
